reviewer: security-auditor (inline by redactor — Task tool unavailable for subagent spawn in this environment)
scope: news_bot.py token redaction surface (regex, _redact_text helper, filter attachment)
summary: All three Decision 12 layers correctly implemented. The new sk-ant-[A-Za-z0-9_=.-]{16,} regex covers prod and sandbox/admin key shapes. The admin-notify path — historically OUTSIDE Python's logging pipeline — now routes through the same _redact_text helper as the logging filter, eliminating M5 (admin-chat key leak via f-string formatting). No new attack surface introduced.

A02_sensitive_data_exposure.details: Three independent redaction paths now cover ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: (1) logging filter on root + httpx-family + anthropic-family loggers; (2) sanitize_error_message via verbatim env-value replacement; (3) send_admin_notification via _redact_text on the message argument.

A09_logging_monitoring_failures.details: _TokenRedactingFilter scrubs records via record.msg rewrite + record.args = None, preventing handler re-format leak. addFilter to root + 4 httpx-family + 3 anthropic-family loggers. Note: Python's addFilter only catches records ORIGINATING on the logger — propagated records from hypothetical future descendants of 'anthropic' (e.g. 'anthropic._streaming') are not directly filtered. Within-spec for Decision 12; flagged as future hardening.

A05_security_misconfiguration.details: send_admin_notification preserves early-return guard for missing creds. _redact_text never raises (try/except + None guard + fallback). Module-level invariant comment instructs future reviewers on type(exc).__name__ template.

A03_injection.details: This change is text-scrubbing only; no new SQL, no new shell, no new dynamic eval.

findings.finding: Python logging Logger.filter() only runs on records originating at that logger, not on propagated records from descendants. A future 'anthropic._streaming' or 'anthropic.tools' logger (if Anthropic SDK adds one) would not have the filter applied — its records would propagate to root, but root's filter does not run on propagated records either. The explicit list in Decision 12 (3 loggers) covers SDK 0.45.x as documented. Mitigation: the admin-notify path goes through _redact_text directly, so the most operator-visible path is covered regardless.
findings.action: out-of-scope — Decision 12 explicitly enumerates the three loggers; broader coverage would require either (a) walking the anthropic logger hierarchy at import time + on-demand, or (b) attaching a Handler-level filter to root's StreamHandler. Both are future hardening, not regressions.

findings.finding: send_admin_notification logs 'Failed to send admin notification: {e}' via logging.error — the {e} text is constructed from a TelegramError thrown by python-telegram-bot, which may include the request URL (containing TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN). Mitigation: (a) the logging filter is attached to root, so this record IS scrubbed via _BOT_TOKEN_RE; (b) the URL form '/bot<TOKEN>/sendMessage' is exactly the shape _BOT_TOKEN_RE matches. Verified by existing TestEndToEndNoTokenInCapturedLogs.
findings.action: no change — existing filter coverage handles this; not a regression introduced by task 04

findings.finding: Pattern sk-ant-[A-Za-z0-9_=.-]{16,} is greedy by default and stops at the first non-matching char (whitespace, quote, comma, etc.). Surrounding text is preserved (verified by test_redact_text_preserves_surrounding_text). Floor of 16 chars after the prefix prevents match on benign tokens like 'sk-ant-shortish' (verified by test_anthropic_regex_does_not_overmatch). Class includes '=' and '.' — minor risk of overmatching version-strings like 'sk-ant-1.2.3-something-very-long' but no realistic false-positive in practice.

tests.regression_coverage: All 28 tests in test_no_token_leak_in_logs.py pass. New tests assert: regex matches both prod and sandbox shapes, filter attached to all 3 anthropic loggers, _redact_text idempotent on clean input, admin-notify scrubs sk-ant- + bot-token + sandbox-key in payload.

exfiltration_paths_audited: stdout/stderr via logging (root + httpx-family + anthropic-family loggers attached)
DB error strings via sanitize_error_message + _SECRET_ENV_NAMES (now includes ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
Telegram admin chat via send_admin_notification (now routes through _redact_text)
Telegram channel posts (out-of-scope — channel posts use translated content, not exception text)
